messages:
ashok: Heads-up — last week we saw repeated thermal throttle events on several A100s in az2 during long inference runs (p99 tail from 750ms -> intermittent spikes to ~1.6s).
maria: can you share the metrics/samples?
ashok: GPU temps sustained 88-92C on 16k token sessions, NVML shows clocks dropping ~25-35%. Quick check: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,clocks.sm --format=csv`.
ashok: proposing a 3h rolling maintenance next Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC to do staggered rack drains + BIOS fan profile rollback + PDU rebalancing. Plan: cordon & drain one rack at a time, reboot nodes, run stress test, then monitor for 24h.
jess: is this firmware, cooling, or a kernel change?
ashok: looks like a combo — higher inlet temps from CRAC setpoint drift + an unintended kernel power-clamp change introduced in the last kernel bump. Canary nodes will get a kernel revert and fan-curve tweak first.
infra-oncall-bot: scheduled maintenance created: https://redwood.internal/maint/19765 — Tue 2026-05-12 02:00-05:00 UTC :wrench:
rafael: how wide will the outage be? impact on Dedicated customers?
ashok: we'll take one rack (6-8 nodes) at a time. Peak capacity hit in az2 ~8-10%. We plan to activate cross-region burst to az1 for best-effort/batch fallback and route latency-sensitive requests to hosted pool for up to 60s while drain completes.
maria: can we pre-warm reserved capacity for a handful of high-commit customers?
ashok: sales & account team notified; for top-tier tenants we'll pre-warm and pin a small dedicated pool in az1. Ops: add an autoscaler holdback so we don't overprovision and inflate costs.
jess: include the exact drain command we will use and pod selection rules.
ashok: drain command we'll use:
```
kubectl drain node-XXXX --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='role!=critical' --grace-period=300
```
ashok: note: critical pods (latency path) are excluded. We also have a model-routing fallback and a 3-min burst cache to avoid large latency spikes.
rafael: cost impact estimate?
maria: rough estimate: cross-region burst + egress ~ $1.5k-2k for the window + possible small SLO credits. Ops to confirm before customer comms.
sre-rotations: can we split into three 1hr windows instead to reduce single-window risk?
ashok: I prefer one contiguous 3hr window to avoid repeated cold starts; we'll still do rack-by-rack within that block to keep per-rack impact minimal. Runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/thermal-az2
jess: ack from eng-runtime, I'll be on-call that night.
maria: I'll draft the status page + customer email. Support: please prepare hold tickets.
support: copied — we'll post a 48h pre-notice and a 2h day-of reminder.
infra-oncall-bot: reminders scheduled: 48h before and 2h before.
ashok: final ask — please react with :thumbsup: if you can be on-call or :wave: if unavailable. Raise objections now if any.
jess: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
rafael: :thumbsup:
sre-rotations: I can cover first rack, might need swap after 02:45 UTC.
ashok: thanks all — I'll update the maint page with the rack sequence and per-rack owners. If anyone needs the canary node IDs or test scripts ping me directly.
